chunks: Then she brought the child to her people, carrying him. They exclaimed: 'O Mary, you have done a most astonishing thing!'

key_terms.تَحْمِلُهُ: carrying him (referring to the infant Jesus)
key_terms.فَرِيّاً: astonishing/new/extraordinary (a thing not previously seen or heard of)

ai.seo_question: What did Mary's people say to her when she brought Jesus to them?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Maryam, Maryam returns to her community in Jerusalem carrying the infant Jesus, triggering a public confrontation where they accuse her of a 'farriyyan' (a significant, novel falsehood or miracle) due to her unexplained pregnancy. Shia exegetes often highlight this moment as the precursor to the infant's miraculous speech, emphasizing that the 'fariyyan' refers not just to the birth itself but to the divine sign that would vindicate her chastity and prophetic lineage. This event underscores the theme of divine validation for the pure, even amidst societal skepticism regarding their status.
